# Motion Mania

> Motion Mania is a desktop app for macOS and Windows that watches Twitch, YouTube or Kick live streams, catches the moment chat reacts to, and edits a vertical 1080×1920 clip with captions and sound. Detection, editing and rendering run on your own computer.

- Free plan: unlimited clipping, post manually.
- Pro: $10/month. Adds Pro Edit, the phone app, auto-upload to YouTube Shorts and TikTok, and AI titles.
- Support: support@motionmania.app

## Product

- [Features](https://motionmania.app/features): real-time detection, vertical layouts, word-level captions, Pro Edit, music, phone approval and auto-upload
- [Pricing](https://motionmania.app/pricing): Free and Pro monthly
- [Download](https://motionmania.app/download): installers, requirements and first-run steps
